pill.desc: white to off-white, round, flat, nonscored tablet

tell: A boxed warning for congestive heart failure and a mechanism that depends on endogenous insulin set this thiazolidinedione apart.

clues.text: Food delays absorption without changing its extent. It is over 99% protein bound, mainly to serum albumin, and extensively metabolized, with 15% to 30% of the dose recovered in urine.
A hydrochloride salt whose active moiety has a molecular weight of 356.4, and it is practically insoluble in water.
Approved under an NDA in 15, 30 and 45 mg tablets, dosed once daily.
Boxed warning: it can cause or worsen congestive heart failure. Contraindicated to start in NYHA class III or IV heart failure, and in hypersensitivity to any component.
Adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control in adults with type 2 diabetes, but not for type 1 diabetes or diabetic ketoacidosis.
It is a PPAR gamma agonist that reduces insulin resistance in peripheral tissues and the liver, and it is not an insulin secretagogue.
The generic name begins with P and has twelve letters.
